questions.prompt: What share of the 2015–16 Warriors' made threes came from Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson?
questions.context: Golden State · 2015–16 regular season · nearest percent
questions.note: 63%: the Splash Brothers made 678 of the team's 1,077 threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a record they broke the following season with 525 and again in the 2015–16 season with 678
source.derivation: Curry and Thompson 678 ÷ Warriors 1,077 × 100 = 62.95, rounded to 63%.

funFacts.text: A season earlier, in 2014–15, Curry and Thompson had combined for 525 threes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the two combined to make 525 threes

funFacts.text: Golden State also led the league in scoring, three-point percentage and assists that season.
